notes.title: Major Update Announcement
notes.notes:
[p]Our game [i]"Victim 10 PM"[/i] was released about 15 days ago. Thank you for all the positive feedback — and of course, the negative as well. Considering this was our first released game, the response has been overwhelmingly encouraging. Every single comment means a lot to us.[/p][p]We’ve just released a quick update. You can find the patch notes below.
We hope you’ll enjoy the game even more in its current form. Thank you for everything![/p][p][b]Update Notes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Lighting atmosphere has been enhanced[/p][/*][*][p]New sound effects have been added[/p][/*][*][p]Particle elements were added to enrich the atmosphere[/p][/*][*][p]Rain has been added to the outdoor area[/p][/*][*][p]Some players reported that textures on certain objects were loading only when approached — this issue has been fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Various graphical and performance improvements have been made[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: The full version of our game will be on Steam in November 2024!
notes.notes: Victim 10 PM is a horror game with many mechanics. Our game has a rich story and features that we think players will love. We would like to hear your ideas for Victim 10 PM, which we plan to release as a full version in November 2024. We are already very excited.
